digest.component_or_area: Configuration ownership gate (RP-04 S7.3) — reconciler engine, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, mcp_server
propositions: Direct ambient config/credential reads (os.getenv, os.environ, load_config) exist below approved composition seams across reconciler engine, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, and mcp_server, causing inconsistent values and seam bypass.

The LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS set must be drained to empty by either cutting reads to approved seams (operation snapshot, startup binding, provider boundary) or registering test-only/protocol-constant entries with exact rationale.

Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job ambient reloads, and migration exceptions must be removed only after their focused behavioral suites (S1-S6) pass and redacted fingerprints/provider-neutral outcomes remain unchanged except for approved deltas.
All below-seam ambient reads, backend reloads, and configurable adapter defaults must have declared single ownership; no path-glob exceptions are permitted in the final gate.
